author: Kushal
problem: A pub quiz scoreboard shows each team's average round score as a whole number, rounding halves up. Return the number shown for a team's round scores (at least one round, no negative scores).
bug_description: Uses round(), which rounds halves to the nearest even number, so averages like 6.5 show as 6 instead of 7.

comments.accurate: Returns the team's mean round score as a whole number for the scoreboard
comments.wrong_behavior: Returns the mean round score as a whole number, with exact halves going to the even neighbour
comments.wrong_location: Rounding checked; the mean may be skewed if a round's score was entered twice
